programme.title: The Secret Kingdom
programme.desc: Dans le manoir familial, Peter et Vérité découvrent un royaume magique caché sous leur chambre, peuplé d'une civilisation de créatures. Cette civilisation est menacée par un ennemi légendaire. Embarqués dans une quête périlleuse afin de retrouver cinq trésors mythiques, ils devront faire face à des défis qui mettront leur bravoure à l'épreuve.

programme.title: The Dog Lover
programme.sub-title: Du mauvais côté de la loi
programme.desc: Sarah, jeune femme passionnée par la cause animale, est envoyée par une association de protection animale dans un élevage de chiens de chasse suspecté de mauvais traitements. Sa mission est d'infiltrer l'élevage en se faisant passer pour une apprentie vétérinaire et de découvrir si les craintes de l'association sont fondées.

programme.title: Stage Fright
programme.desc: Bien décidée à suivre les pas de sa mère, ancienne diva de Broadway, Camilla passe un casting et décroche un rôle dans une pièce. Mais les répétitions tournent vite au bain de sang.

programme.title: Baron rouge
programme.desc: Allemagne, Première Guerre mondiale : le célèbre pilote Manfred von Richthofen, alias Le Baron Rouge, tombe amoureux de Käte et réalise que son image sert la propagande.

programme.title: De Guerre Lasse (Marseille)
programme.desc: Alex, fils d'un caïd marseillais, déserte la Légion pour retrouver Katia. À son retour, Marseille est dominée par les Corses et les gangs, menaçant sa famille.

programme.title: Ghost Stories
programme.desc: Le professeur Goodman, en enquêtant sur trois événements paranormaux effrayants, voit sa rationalité vaciller. Il se demande si son esprit lui joue des tours ou si des forces surnaturelles existent.

programme.title: Le rêveur et les truands
programme.desc: 2 voyous attendent dans une vieille Lada, au milieu d'une rue déserte. Leurs complices ont braqué un fourgon blindé et se sont cachés dans les égouts. Les 2 hommes, chargés de les récupérer en voiture, ont la tache la plus simple : attendre...

programme.title: Chat
programme.desc: Bien qu'adulte, Emma vient de découvrir ce que ce mot veut dire. Elle va maintenant apprendre à le représenter avec l'aide d'autres personnes en situations de handicap comme elle, et le support d'Elisabeth, l'éducatrice. Emma ne sait pas se livrer, mais est-elle celle qui freine le plus à dévoiler ses sentiments ?

programme.title: Chronique de la jungle
programme.desc: On l'appelle “Le Chat”. D'origine très modeste, Le Chat gagne sa vie dans le monde de la nuit, en dealant de la cocaïne. Pour obtenir de la drogue, il hypnotise des femmes et propose à des hommes riches mais frustrés, de les posséder, en échange de plusieurs grammes... Mais ce soir, il va croiser Diane, une prédatrice qui va l'affronter... et le faire vaciller.

programme.title: Magie noire
programme.desc: La lumière est en clair-obscur. Le plateau est nu. La salle est vide. Les couloirs sont déserts. Deux tziganes. Des vrais chanteurs. Deux histoires parallèles : la tzigane et les auditions des chanteurs. L'enchevêtrement des deux mondes à travers le chant de l'opéra. Un univers visuel et sonore. Peu importe ce que disent les paroles, c'est l'imaginaire qui commande.

programme.title: Othello
programme.desc: Abd Al Malik actualise le chef d'œuvre de Verdi en le situant de nos jours dans un contexte urbain. Le réalisateur a choisi d'écrire les courts dialogues dans des intertitres, des cartons empruntés au cinéma muet, la bande-son étant constituée de la musique de l'opéra de Verdi arrangée par Arnaud de Solignac.

programme.title: Le Graffiti
programme.desc: Stupeur dans la ville ce matin : un graffiti est apparu sur la façade d'un édifice historique ! Les principaux concernés par l'inscription, le Maire et le Docteur Robin, vont devoir s'expliquer…

programme.title: Trois petits points
programme.desc: Une petite couturière attend son mari parti à la guerre.

programme.title: Rhapsodie pour un pot-au-feu
programme.desc: Trois générations d'une même famille cohabitent sous le même toit dans une chorégraphie désaccordée. La mère, chef d'orchestre de la famille, tente en vain de les réunir à table pour le dîner.

programme.title: Floating in my mind
programme.desc: Un film qui raconte l'histoire de la vie, de rencontres, de souvenirs...

programme.title: Le dernier jour d'un condamné
programme.desc: Camille, une jeune lycéenne, est en pleines révisions. Lassée par son travail, Camille jette un œil dans le frigidaire et y trouve un homard vivant. Se prenant d'affection pour l'animal, l'adolescente décide de lui faire vivre les plus belles heures de son existence...

programme.title: A Shadow of blue
programme.desc: Un soir d'automne, dans un parc situé au milieu d'une ville morne, une petite fille assise sur un banc, nous fait partager plusieurs visions d'une même réalité.

programme.title: Totems
programme.desc: Un bûcheron travaille dans la forêt quand un arbre s'écrase sur lui et l'immobilise. La détresse réveille alors l'animal caché en lui…

programme.title: Pim Poum le petit Panda
programme.desc: Pour Daniel, Pim-Poum le panda c'est presque le rôle de sa vie. Presque, parce que dans le fond ce qui l'intéresse c'est d'être payé. En compagnie de Lucie et Caro, et sous la direction de Marie-Agnès, ils vont se présenter devant leur public : un groupe d'enfants de 5 ans. Alors que la représentation aurait pu bien se dérouler, les interêts de chacun, l'interprétation des personnages et la mise en scène font virer le spectacle au désastre.

programme.title: Le distributeur d'aurores boréales
programme.desc: Lola collectionne les horloges cassées depuis qu'elle a perdu sa mère. Une nuit, elle découvre que l'une d'elle est hantée... Peut-on tomber amoureux d'un fantôme? Que se passerait-il s'il revenait dans la réalité ?

programme.title: Regards libres
programme.desc: Des enfants observent, commentent et critiquent un tableau.

programme.title: Tomatl, chronique de la fin d'un monde
programme.desc: La tomate fut découverte par les européens en même temps que le Nouveau Monde. Les Aztèques léguèrent cette plante, qui couvre aujourd'hui le tiers des surfaces de la planète...

programme.title: Kroak
programme.desc: Kroak part pêcher tôt le matin. De son baluchon, il sort tout une panoplie d'outils et attend le poisson qui ne vient pas. Lorsque ça mord enfin, c'est un refrigérateur qui sort de l'eau, puis une table dressée et enfin un drôle de poisson.

programme.title: Personne ne s'aimera jamais comme on s'aime
programme.desc: Pauline et Noham s'aiment à la folie. Quand la mère de Pauline lui annonce qu'elles déménagent à Paris, Pauline, incapable de se séparer de Noham, décide de rester vivre dans sa ville natale. Seulement voilà, Pauline n'a que dix ans…

programme.title: Le bûcheron des mots
programme.desc: Dans un pays où les habitants se nourrissent, au sens propre, de lettres et de mots cueillis dans les arbres, la lecture est vitale s'ils ne veulent pas mourir... d'ennui. Mais certains livres sont interdits à cause de leur contenu émotionnel et des transformations physiques qu'ils provoquent. Nadal, un bûcheron des mots, fait une rencontre qui change définitivement sa vie...

programme.title: Circuit marine
programme.desc: Un bateau en haute mer, les marins pêchent, mangent, boivent...et chantent. Le chat regarde le perroquet, le perroquet regarde le joli poisson dans son bocal, le chat regarde le poisson... Qui mangera qui ?

programme.title: La grande migration
programme.desc: Les aventures humoristiques d'un oiseau migrateur qui perd ses congénères dans les nuages...

programme.title: Una furtiva lagrima
programme.desc: Ultime voyage d'un poisson qui chante son propre requiem, depuis la vente à la poissonnerie jusque dans la poêle à frire.

programme.title: Le commissaire perdrix ne fait pas le voyage pour rien
programme.desc: Anselmini, ancien truand, est un homme seul mais libre. Cette liberté, c'est précisément ce que sont venus prendre le Commissaire Perdrix et le Lieutenant Webb, deux flics perdus dans un pays, dans une temporalité qui ne sont pas les leurs.

programme.title: Tourmente
programme.desc: Depuis qu'il a abandonné son équipage lors du naufrage de son bateau, le capitaine Mandarin est maudit par la mer.

programme.title: Ride away
programme.desc: Arrivée au bout de la route, une vieille motarde ressent le besoin de faire un dernier voyage.

programme.title: Automne
programme.desc: Une femme reçoit une lettre adressée à l'ancienne locataire.

programme.title: Tropical suite
programme.desc: Après dix ans de collaboration, Poni Hoax part enregistrer un quatrième album décisif sous les tropiques : Cape Town (Afrique du Sud), São Paulo (Brésil) et Bangkok (Thaïlande). Tropical Suite raconte ce voyage au cœur de la création. Bien plus qu'un making of, ce documentaire révèle la quête musicale et intime d'un des meilleurs groupes de rock français.

programme.title: Je suis l'ombre de mes envies
programme.desc: C'est l'histoire d'un homme sous influence...

programme.title: Pisseuse
programme.desc: Mona a quinze ans, elle fait encore pipi au lit. Aucun remède ne vient la secourir. Elle trouve seule le chemin de sa liberté.

programme.title: Night Hunter
programme.desc: Les enjeux n'ont jamais été aussi élevés pour la star de l'action Don « The Dragon » Wilson ! Le chasseur de vampires Jack Cutter (Wilson) doit accomplir son destin et détruire les dernières créatures suceuses de sang de la nuit avant qu'un désastre impie ne se produise.

programme.title: Swim
programme.desc: Une famille est prise au piège alors que la maison de vacances qu'elle loue est inondée par la pluie et qu'un requin agressif a réussi à s'y introduire.

programme.title: Triple Action
programme.desc: Une mercenaire sexy et mortelle s'attaque à un syndicat international de trafiquants d'armes dirigé par la mafia russe.

programme.title: Hercules Reborn
programme.desc: La fiancée d'un jeune homme est kidnappée par un roi impitoyable, Hercule est appelé à l'aide. En exil depuis des années, le guerrier retrouve l'espoir à travers l'amour du garçon pour sa bien-aimée. Ensemble, ils vont combattre le tyran.

programme.title: La vie secrète de mon mari
programme.desc: Une femme ntame une liaison extraconjugale, mais il s'agit d'un plan visant à éliminer son mari ,,,

programme.title: Ruby: héritage empoisonné
programme.desc: Ruby devait interviewer la fondatrice de Nathalie au Naturel, mais elle meurt dans un accident de voiture.

programme.title: L'Édition de l'Amour
programme.desc: Une rédactrice beauté persuade un photographe de simuler une relation, mais des sentiments réels naissent.

programme.title: Petits meurtres sur le campus
programme.desc: Amy Winslow, professeur de littérature spécialisée dans le roman policier, enquête sur la mort d'un étudiant.

programme.title: Les fantômes du passé
programme.desc: Amy est invitée à Seattle pour donner une conférence sur le roman policier et une mort suspecte survient.

programme.title: Teeth
programme.desc: Une adolescente dotée d'une étrange mutation corporelle commence à réaliser qu'elle peut l'utiliser à son avantage après une rencontre effrayante avec un garçon de l'école. Toujours étrangère à son propre corps, une lycéenne découvre qu'elle a un avantage physique lorsqu'elle devient l'otage d'un garçon.

programme.title: Les rescapés
programme.desc: Un jeune homme découvre que son père vient d'une autre dimension et qu'il est la clé d'activation d'un cristal qui pourrait être décisif dans la guerre entre les différentes dimensions

programme.title: L'île de nim
programme.desc: Une jeune fille vie sur une île isolée avec son père scientifique et communique avec l'auteur reclus de ses romans préférés.

programme.title: Mazes and Monsters
programme.desc: Robbie, un étudiant un peu ringard, est obsédé par le jeu de rôle « Mazes and Monsters », auquel il joue avec ses quatre camarades de classe tout aussi geeks. Un soir, le groupe décide de jouer dans une caverne, et Robbie commence à subir d'étranges visions qui brouillent la frontière entre réel et imaginaire.

programme.title: Vampire in Brooklyn
programme.desc: En tant que vampire Maximilian, Eddie Murphy est le mort-vivant le plus diabolique et élégant à New York.

programme.title: Beyond the Edge
programme.desc: Une bande d'arnaqueurs talentueux dotés de superpouvoirs tente de dévaliser un énorme casino, mais c'est sans compter sur un mystérieux rival qui semble tous les surpasser…

programme.title: VENDETTA
programme.desc: Lorsque sa fille se fait assassiner, William Duncan décide de rendre justice lui-même. Après avoir tué l'homme responsable de sa mort, il se trouve en guerre contre son frère, son père et leur gang.

programme.title: Vice
programme.desc: Dans le futur, des humanoïdes sont utilisés comme esclaves par de riches clients afin d'assouvir leurs fantasmes les plus sombres.

programme.title: Le Duel
programme.desc: Un Texas Ranger enquête sur une série de décès inexpliqués dans une ville appelée Helena.

programme.title: Serieously Ep.31
programme.desc: Ton rendez-vous francophone préféré sur les séries, le cinéma et la pop culture en général!

programme.title: Écran Large Ep.4
programme.desc: Écran Large : actu ciné, séries, comics, jeux vidéo

programme.title: Écran Large Ep.8
programme.desc: Écran Large : actu ciné, séries, comics, jeux vidéo

programme.title: Last Survivors
programme.desc: Un père et son fils, rencontrent un étranger qui menace de détruire l'utopie qu'ils ont construite.

programme.title: Serieously Ep.32
programme.desc: Ton rendez-vous francophone préféré sur les séries, le cinéma et la pop culture en général!

programme.title: Contaminations
programme.desc: Un baron de l'industrie pétrolière est confronté à un fermier dont la ferme a été polluée.

programme.title: Embrassez le marié!
programme.desc: Matt et Ryan étaient amants au lycée. Dix ans plus tard, Matt reçoit une invitation au mariage de Ryan et de sa future épouse Alex. D'abord stupéfait de par l'annonce du mariage, il repart dans sa ville natale afin d'essayer de renouer un contact avec son amour de jeunesse.

programme.title: Célibataires ou presque
programme.desc: Trois amis se jurent de demeurer célibataires, ce qui crée des conflits avec la gent féminine... et même entre eux. Daniel voit secrètement une amie du trio, Mikey fait l'impossible pour reconquérir son épouse infidèle. Jason, lui, cumule les aventures d'un soir.

programme.title: Comment Savoir
programme.desc: Lisa ne vivait que pour sa passion du sport et du softball, mais sa soudaine exclusion de son club la laisse complètement désemparée. C'est alors qu'elle fait la connaissance de Matty, un joueur de baseball professionnel, séducteur invétéré plutôt nombriliste...

programme.title: Supernova
programme.desc: Sam et Tusker s'aiment depuis 20 ans. À bord de leur vieux camping-car, ils rendent visite à leurs amis et famille et retournent sur les lieux de leur jeunesse.

programme.title: L'Histoire de l'Amour
programme.desc: The story of a long-lost book that mysteriously reappears and connects an old man searching for his son with a girl seeking a cure for her mother's loneliness.

programme.title: Une Pluie sans Fin
programme.desc: Un homme licencié d'une aciérie veut désespérément traquer un tueur en série dans une petite ville du sud de la Chine.

programme.title: Le Signal
programme.desc: Lors d'un road trip, Nic et deux amis sont attirés dans une région isolée par un génie de l'informatique. Quand tout devient soudainement noir, Nic reprend conscience, pour se retrouver dans un cauchemar éveillé.

programme.title: Pan Yuliang Artiste Peintre
programme.desc: Pan Yuliang, ou le destin extraordinaire d'un enfant de la pauvreté devenu artiste mondialement connu.

programme.title: The Cake Eaters: Absolution in Love
programme.desc: Deux familles se retrouvent à l'occasion du retour de l'un des fils. Mais ces retrouvailles vont faire réapparaître de vieux fantômes...

programme.title: Le Casse-Coeur
programme.desc: En plein cambriolage dans une maison, harry rencontre daisy et décide de la sauver d'elle-même.

programme.title: Elle: La Cendrillon des temps modernes
programme.desc: Il était une fois, Elle rêvait de devenir une chanteuse célèbre, mais maintenant elle vit à Los Angeles en faisant un stage dans une maison de disques. Un jour, elle rencontre son prince charmant pop, mais un petit problème surgit : les divas de la maison de disques feront tout pour empêcher son succès. Avec l'aide de ses amis, Elle prouve que les rêves se réalisent et que le "heureux pour toujours" n'est qu'à une chanson de distance.

programme.title: The Cake Eaters: Absolution in Love
programme.desc: Deux familles se retrouvent à l'occasion du retour de l'un des fils. Mais ces retrouvailles vont faire réapparaître de vieux fantômes...

programme.title: Pixels
programme.desc: Lorsque des extraterrestres débarquent sur notre planète et prennent la forme de PAC MAN, Donkey Kong, Galaga, Centipede et Space Invaders pour nous attaquer, le président Will Cooper (Kevin James) doit faire appel à une équipe un peu particulière pour nous sauver. Sam (Adam Sandler), Ludlow (Josh Gad) et Eddie (Peter Dinklage), experts en jeux d'arcades dans les années 80, vont devoir ensemble faire face à leurs personnages préférés pour sauver la Terre, en comptant sur leur expertise, et sur des armes uniques

programme.title: Espion Et Demi
programme.desc: Un boxeur professionnel doit aider un agent du gouvernement américain à retrouver un avion espion disparu avant qu'il ne tombe entre les mains de terroristes.

programme.title: Self Control
programme.desc: Dave Buznik est un homme calme et doux qui n'aime pas les situations conflictuelles jusqu'au jour où, à la suite d'une altercation dans un avion, et malgré lui, il se trouve dans l'obligation de suivre une thérapie supposée contrôler sa colère.

programme.title: S.O.S Fantômes II
programme.desc: Après l'extermination totale de tous les revenants dans la ville de New York, la joyeuse équipe de S.O.S Fantômes reprend du service (après un chômage technique long de cinq ans) quand leur amie Dana découvre que son bébé Oscar est l'objet de phénomènes paranormaux.

programme.title: Mayhem
programme.desc: Un virus se propage dans un cabinet d'avocats le jour où le jeune Derek est piégé par un collègue et injustement licencié, transformant les collaborateurs en bêtes sanguinaires.

programme.title: Snake Outta Compton
programme.desc: Un groupe de rap débarque dans l'endroit le plus dangereux des États-Unis, Compton, la banlieue ghetto de Los Angeles, dans le but de signer leur tout premier contrat d'enregistrement. Peu de temps après, les membres de ce groupe de rap finissent par devenir le seul espoir de la ville.

programme.title: The Toll
programme.desc: Brendan occupe tout seul un petit poste de péage sur une route secondaire du Pays de Galles. Il est au calme dans cet endroit, ce qui lui permet de dissimuler son passé criminel. Un jour, il est dévalisé par des malfaiteurs maladroits.

programme.title: L'Arnaqueuse
programme.desc: Peg Dahl est une jeune femme qui espère quitter sa ville natale de Buffalo. Elle se lance dans le business du recouvrement de dettes. La guerre est déclarée avec le Roi des chasseurs de dettes de Buffalo.

programme.title: Le retour de Billy the Kid
programme.desc: Billy the Kid tente de vivre en paix, sous un nouveau nom et dans une ville frontalière, mais il est approché par un prédicateur qui lui demande de l'aider à libérer la ville d'un homme impitoyable et de son tireur.

programme.title: Randy le Solitaire
programme.desc: Emprisonné pour des meurtres qu'il n'a pas commis, Randy s'évade et tombe sur le repaire des vrais meurtriers.

programme.title: Daniel Boone
programme.desc: Daniel Boone conduit des colons dans le Kentucky, mais il doit affronter les Indiens Shawnee qui ont été persuadés par un renégat français que Boone et les colons sont là pour les tuer et leur voler leurs terres.

programme.title: Le temps du massacre
programme.desc: Un chercheur d'or et son demi-frère ivrogne doivent affronter un fermier et son fils sadique après avoir pris le contrôle de sa ferme.

programme.title: Bonanza
programme.desc: Les Cartwright viennent en aide à un ouvrier d'écurie sino-américain accusé de meurtre. Face à eux, un candidat à la mairie manipulateur qui veut que tous les "étrangers" quittent Virginia City.

programme.title: Big Foot
programme.desc: En 1970, deux hommes aux destins opposés : Harley Anderson et Simon Quint doivent s'unir pour chasser une créature légendaire vivant dans les montagnes : le `Big foot'.

programme.title: La Nuit Des Morts-Vivants 3D
programme.desc: En arrivant au cimetière pour l'enterrement de leur tante, Barb et son frère Johnny sont surpris de ne trouver personne. Leur étonnement vire à la panique lorsqu'ils découvrent que le cimetière est envahi par des zombies qui les pourchassent.

programme.title: The Battery
programme.desc: Au cours d'un road-trip à travers les Etats-Unis, au cours duquel ils doivent faire face à des morts-vivants, deux anciens joueurs de base-ball s'aperçoivent qu'ils devront aussi faire face à leurs propres démons.

programme.title: The Blazing World
programme.desc: Des décennies après la noyade accidentelle de sa soeur jumelle, une jeune femme autodestructrice retourne dans sa maison familiale, se retrouvant attirée par une autre dimension où sa soeur est peut-être encore en vie.

programme.title: L'Homme qui a tué Hitler et puis le Bigfoot
programme.desc: Un ancien soldat américain légendaire a pour mission de pourchasser une créature mythique.

programme.title: 400 Days
programme.desc: Quatre astronautes sont envoyés en mission scientifique de simulation pour tester les effets psychologiques des voyages dans l'espace. Enfermés durant 400 jours dans un simulateur , l'état mental de l'équipage se détériore lorsque qu'ils perdent toute communication avec le monde extérieur.

programme.title: La guerre des mondes: L'invasion
programme.desc: Trois amis fans d'astronomie cherchent le point d'impact de ce qu'ils croient être une météorite.

programme.title: Narcopolis
programme.desc: Londres, 2024. Les drogues, devenues légales à la fabrication et à la consommation, sont contrôlées et exploitées par des sociétés pharmaceutiques. Mais un marché noir de substances bien plus dangereuses encore existe.

programme.title: Super Shark
programme.desc: Un forage offshore réveille un requin préhistorique géant. La biologiste Kate enquête mais doit faire face aux manigances de Roger et Stewart. Aidée de Skipper et du DJ Dynamite Stevens, elle cherche à stopper le monstre, désormais capable de marcher sur terre : le Super Shark.

programme.title: The Outpost Dorénavant, cet avant-poste est à nous
programme.desc: La chaine 100% science-fiction et fantastique. Zone réservée aux fans de films et séries SF : catastrophes, zombies, extraterrestres, paranormal, space opéras, vampires, mondes perdus et créatures mutantes sont au programme

programme.desc: En rentrant d'une soirée arrosée avec ses collègues, un officier de police renverse un jeune cycliste. Alors qu'il tente de réanimer l'enfant, il ment aux policiers venus prendre sa déposition...

programme.title: A l'ombre des regards
programme.desc: Holly est une jeune femme qui se laisse dépérir depuis la mort de sa mère jusqu'à ce qu'elle fasse la connaissance de Shane, un champion de MMA déchu.

programme.title: The Mysteries of Pittsburgh
programme.desc: L'été décisif d'un jeune diplômé qui s'oppose à son père gangster et explore l'amour, la sexualité et les énigmes qui entourent sa vie et sa ville.

programme.title: The Girl in the Book
programme.desc: Dans le milieu de l'édition new-yorkaise, une jeune éditrice est contrainte de faire face à un chapitre troublant de son passé lorsqu'un auteur à succès réapparaît dans sa vie.

programme.title: Mafia Inc
programme.desc: Les Gamache, couturiers de père en fils, habillent la famille mafieuse Paternò. Vince travaille au nom de Frank, le parrain, avec son fils aîné Giaco. Vince cherche à faire ses preuves et impressionner le parrain.

programme.title: La Vague
programme.desc: Un professeur de lycée cherche à expliquer à ses élèves ce qu'est la vie sous une dictature. L'expérience tourne mal alors que ses élèves échappent à son contrôle.

programme.title: Night Walk
programme.desc: Dans cette version moderne de Roméo et Juliette, les amoureux maudits sont déchirés par les tensions culturelles entre l'Orient et l'Occident.

programme.title: Anti-social
programme.desc: Le centre de Londres, aujourd'hui Dee est un artiste de rue anarchique confronté au système, Marcus est un voleur à main armée sur une vague de crime dans une bijouterie. Pour les deux frères, être antisocial est un mode de vie.

programme.title: In Search of Darkness
programme.desc: Plongez dans l'horreur des années 80 avec cette conclusion gargantuesque qui s'attaque à l'âge d'or de la VHS et des vidéoclubs, dresse les portraits d'artistes et artisans incontournables et aborde de nombreuses pépites oubliées d'un cinéma imaginatif, sanglant, expérimental, indispensable…

programme.title: Vigilante
programme.desc: Fou de rage après l'agression de son épouse et le meurtre de son fils et écœuré par le laxisme et la corruption des autorités, qui ont permis aux responsables d'être libérés, un électricien new-yorkais s'acoquine avec un groupe d'auto-défense, dans lequel il refusait d'entrer jusqu'alors, afin de venger sa famille.

programme.title: Malum
programme.desc: Une jeune policière tente de percer le lien mystérieux entre la mort de son père et l'arrestation d'une secte. Pour ce faire, elle accepte de prendre poste dans le commissariat où son père a trouvé la mort. Bientôt, elle est victime d'événements surnaturels terrifiants...

programme.title: Le Masque du Démon
programme.desc: Au 17ème siècle, la sorcière Asa et son amant Igor, accusés de vampirisme, sont mis au supplice mais promettent une vengeance éternelle à leurs tortionnaires. Deux siècles plus tard, la malédiction se réalise : les vampires reviennent à la vie et recommencent à semer la terreur et la mort...

programme.title: Spit'n'Split
programme.desc: Une tournée de rock band, c'est des fans prêtes à tomber le tanga pour un autographe, des brouettes de coke et des pluies de billets. Les membres de ce groupe de rock aimeraient confirmer ce mythe. Sauf qu'eux, ce sont des longs trajets dans un van pourri, de l'aspirine et des bars vides.

programme.title: Middle Men
programme.desc: Un businessman ambitieux lance le premier site pornographique payant à l'aube d'Internet.

programme.title: Mutant Tiger Chronicles
programme.desc: Chine, 560 après J.-C. Un étrange virus infecte des tigres assoiffés de sang.

programme.title: Borrego
programme.desc: Après un crash dans le désert, une botaniste est retenue captive par un trafiquant de drogue.

programme.title: Bullet Proof
programme.desc: Après avoir volé des millions à un mafieux, un voleur découvre à bord sa compagne enceinte.

programme.title: Collection
programme.desc: Brandon, collecteur de dettes brisé par la perte de son fils, hésite à ruiner Christina, une mère seule piégée par les crimes de son mari. Contre ses principes et son partenaire, il choisit de l'aider.

programme.title: South Wind
programme.desc: Peter est un jeune délinquant de Belgrade plein d'ambition, spécialisé dans le vol de voitures. Mais le jour où il se trompe de véhicule, il se met à dos le chef des narcotrafiquants de la ville.

programme.title: Lady Gun Fighter
programme.desc: 1882, dans une île au sud de la Nouvelle-Zélande, une mère se lance sur les traces du meurtrier de son mari, responsable de l'enlèvement de son fils.

programme.title: Drive Hard
programme.desc: Simon Keller, braqueur, cherche un pilote pour assurer sa fuite lors de son prochain casse. Il réussit a enrôler de force Peter Roberts, ancien champion de F1.

programme.title: Asher
programme.desc: Ancien agent du Mossad, Asher est désormais mercenaire professionnel. Proche de prendre sa retraite, il rencontre Sophie et va tenter avec elle de mener une vie normale avant qu'il ne soit trop tard.

programme.title: Proud Mary
programme.desc: Mary (Taraji P. Henson), une dangereuse tueuse à gages, travaille pour la famille du crime la plus célèbre de la ville, dirigée par Benny (Danny Glover). Lorsque Mary tue un mafieux sous protection pour sauver un jeune garçon, elle doit faire face à de nombreux criminels de renom, y compris son ancien amant. Armée de son ingéniosité - et d'un placard rempli d'armes - Mary doit faire le nécessaire pour survivre…

programme.title: Memoire Effacee
programme.desc: Hantée par la mort de son fils, Telly s'entend affirmer par un psychiatre que l'enfant n'a jamais existé, et qu'elle est victime d'hallucinations. Et elle ne retrouve effectivement aucune trace du disparu... En compagne d'Ash, qui a aussi perdu son enfant dans le même crash aérien, Telly va tenter de faire éclater la vérité

programme.title: L'Art De La Guerre 2
programme.desc: L'agent spécial Neil Shaw est de retour dans ce nouveau film d'action et d'aventure où tous les coups sont permis. En retraite, Shaw est consultant à Hollywood mais reprend du service quand l'un de ses maîtres en arts martiaux se fait tuer. Shaw se retrouve au milieu des intrigues politiques de Washington lorsqu'il découvre un complot visant à assassiner plusieurs sénateurs.

programme.title: Armored
programme.desc: Après la mort de ses parents, Ty rentre d'Irak où il était soldat pour s'occuper de son petit frère. Pour faire face aux factures, il accepte de travailler comme convoyeur de fonds pour la société qui employait son père. Au dernier jour de sa période d'essai, Ty se voit proposer par Cochrane, son chef d'équipe, de voler les 42 millions de dollars qu'ils doivent bientôt transporter. Le plan est aussi simple que génial : pas d'armes, pas de victimes, pas de violence, et aucune preuve... Toute l'équipe est dans le coup. D'abord réticent, Ty finit par accepter. Le jour J, le plan se déroule sans accrocs, jusqu'à ce qu'un imprévu fasse tout déraper...

programme.title: Golda
programme.desc: Le 6 octobre 1973, en pleine fête du Kippour, les forces combinées de l'Égypte, de la Syrie et de la Jordanie lancent une attaque surprise sur Israël.

programme.desc: "Max" raconte l'adolescence d'un jeune homme qui subit un deuil et se console auprès du chien de guerre héroïque qui accompagnait son frère mort au combat.

programme.title: Mourir ou Survivre
programme.desc: Une ambitieuse journaliste postée au Moyen-Orient est faite prisonnière après que son convoi a été pris en embuscade. Elle est confrontée au traumatisme de son passé et doit trouver un moyen de faire tomber les militants qui l'ont incarcérée.

programme.sub-title: The Blue and White Island World of Greece: Mykonos, Naxos and Tinos
programme.desc: Around the once sacred Isle of Delos, some 200 islands, including 20 larger ones, are arranged almost in a circle. This is where the name of the Greek island paradise comes from: Cyclades, a derivation of the Greek word kýklos, circle. Each cyclade has a unique character. The pelican Petros, about 20 years old, is the mascot of Mykonos. He moves from taverna to taverna all day long, scrounging fish. This works out sometimes well and sometimes not so well. Petros does have a few human friends who regularly slip him something, but all too often visitors eager to take pictures block his path. Then he has to "wiggle" his way through the crowd. Jackie Onassis is said to have once brought Petros' "great-grandmother" from Louisiana to the island.

programme.title: mareTV
programme.desc: The Santorini archipelago is a gem, but is located on a veritable powder keg. It is only a matter of time before the volcano, the crater rim of which gave us this island world, erupts again. Since January 2011, threatening rumblings have been perceived beneath the archipelago. On Santorini, it's a case of getting nowhere fast without a mule. Whether the restaurant terraces above the abyss of Oia, the hotels on the breath-taking cliffs of Imerovigli or Firostefani, it was only with the help of the stubborn climbing artists, that these daring constructions were made possible. Antonis Vlachos has ten strong mules that work for him. He transports almost everything with them: stones, food or the typically blue paint for the church domes. Santorini is a tourist magnet and up to five cruise ships call in at the islands daily. However, there is no port, just a narrow, concrete quay. Without the tender boats, no guests would ever reach the shore.

programme.title: North Macedonia: Between Traditional Dances and Mini Navy
programme.desc: Northern Macedonia emerged from being a once constituent republic of the former Yugoslavia. Anyone wishing to discover unknown worlds has every chance of finding them in this young Balkan country, full of imposing mountains, lakes of crystal-clear water, original villages and centuries-old customs. Nevertheless, Northern Macedonia, which borders Serbia in the north and Greece in the south, considered to be one of the poorest countries in Europe.

programme.title: The Turkish Riviera
programme.sub-title: The flair of antiquity and a turquoise sea
programme.desc: With a coastline boasting miles of bathing beaches, turquoise waters, breath-taking cliffs whilst being steeped in history, the Turkish riviera was even a fa-vourite of the Ancient Greeks, Romans and Ottomans, who all loved the mild climate and the lush landscape. Near the ruins of the ancient city of Side, Menderes Akdemir works on the latest attraction aimed at Riviera holidaymakers: his spooky pirate ship "Big Kral" is due to leave dry dock and head for the sea. Mehmet Özata came up with a very clever idea: to be able to cope with the basically ruinous puffer fish plague along the coastline, he produces a selection of leather utensils made of their skin. The islands that surround the sunk-en city of Simena are hugely popular, despite the very modest infrastructure and lack of shopping facilities. This is why Fatma and Ahmet Mazili have transformed their small rowing boat into a floating snack bar. An-other gap in the market was brought to life by Ufuk Secgin. He came up with the idea of providing Halal Holidays, vacations that conform to Islam. For Muslims to be able to relax on holiday, much has to be well organised, with a copy of the Koran and a prayer rug seen as the absolute minimum requirements

programme.desc: From the BerryWorks to Strawberry's Café, everyone is excited about who will win this year's Spring Flower Festival! programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.sub-title: The Mystery of the Disappearing Dog Show
programme.desc: When Huckleberry and Blueberry's Patti Persimmon-style mystery story is rejected by an online mystery magazine, Blueberry and Huck have to come up with a new way to raise support for Huckleberry's Hotel for Homeless Pets back in Berry Big City. Strawberry suggests they hold a big dog show! Plum makes over-ambitious plans to display talents that her dog does not quite have, trying to teach him complicated dance routines.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: The Baby Berrykins are enthralled by a fairytale that Blueberry reads to them for Story Time. Charmed by their reaction, Strawberry suggests that the girls do a "berrytale play" for the kids, sort of a "Story Time On Stage." Plum volunteers to direct it. She envisions a small, simple production-until she hears about a gigantic production of "Snowberry and the Seven Berrykins" that's a smash hit in Berry Big City.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: At the next Storytime, Strawberry is going to read a new poem. We see her at the podium as she finishes writing it, one afternoon when no one else is in the café except Custard and Pupcake. Strawberry clears her throat and reads the poem aloud. It's a simple, sweet rhyme about the magic of making wishes on falling stars. She tries a few different rhymes as she goes, noting them on her paper. She is startled to hear applause from Mr. Longface Caterpillar who has heard her recital.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: From the BerryWorks to Strawberry's Café, everyone is excited about who will win this year's Spring Flower Festival! programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Strawberry Shortcake's friends watch her with wide eyes as she everrrrr-so-gently squirts a layer of blueberry smoothie into a tall glass, trying to not disturb the five other multi-colored layers beneath it. It's her tenth attempt to create the world's first Rainbow Smoothie! She has even painted one wall of her café rainbow colors in honor of the soon-to-be new item on the menu. No one dares breathe for fear of spoiling the delicate touch of a master smoothie-squirter at work.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: It's a busy day at Lemon's salon, a charming place that is more than just a hair salon it's one of favorite places for Strawberry and her friends to relax and socialize. All the girls are getting their hair done for the gala grand opening of Mr. Longface's new lawn-bowling and croquet club. They're spirited and laughing and chatting and having a great time, as Lemon runs from one of her friends to the next, doing hair and nails, serving tea and cookies.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.sub-title: The Berry Best You Can Bee
programme.desc: Strawberry is at Orange's store to mail a birthday card to a friend in Big Bitty City. Just after she drops the card into the mail slot, an ill postal carrier bee sneezes sending envelopes and post cards flying in all directions. The two girls help Jadeybug, a postal clerk, and Postmaster Bee gather up the strewn letters and the ill bee gets sent home from work.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: While rehearsing a song alone in her cafe, Strawberry is interrupted by the arrival of Jadeybug. The poor ladybug is stressed out because her twin cousins, Kadiebug and Sadiebug, left her a message that they are coming to visit for a whole week. Jadey is unable to host them because she's having her guest room repainted.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: While at Orange's general store to pick up a package, Berrykin Bloom chats with Orange about the pogostick he gave her to help her reach the upper shelves. She is very appreciative. He ends up getting a package of special berry seeds he ordered, not the vacation magazine Orange thought he came for. He explains how the seeds were a better purchase because of all the benefits to the Berryworks but now he can no longer afford a vacation.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Plum decides to hold a dance recital at Strawberry's Café Cabaret stage and sends out a stack of invitations. She forgets, however, to check the sign-up sheet at the Café and schedules it for the same night as Blueberry is scheduled to read to the baby Berrykins. Strawberry tells Plum she cannot hold the recital in the Café on her chosen day because the Café is booked.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Strawberry opens her front door to a throng of Berrykins all cheering for the new BerryFest Princess. She is appreciative of their admiration but unsure of exactly what her duties entail. In response the Berrykins bombard her with her duties - major to miniscule. One Berrykin sums it up by telling her she's responsible for presiding over all the activities of the BerryFest to make it the best.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: All of Berry Bitty City is excitedly making their way through the berry batch in search of the elusive Wanderberry. It is to be the dessert at the BerryFest Feast. Everyone is milling about searching for it on their own when Blueberry points out that the rules say the BerryFest Princess is in charge of the search. The girls turn to her for direction and she points them where she thinks the berry might be.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.sub-title: Nothing To Fear But Berries Themselves
programme.desc: Overhearing Blueberry reading a story to the baby Berrykins about the scary Galumphalot, Orange is uncharacteristically shaken. She determines she doesn't want anything scary around her, just relaxation. But while the girls are having a hair-styling party at Lemon's salon, a malfunction at the BerryWorks causes the whole town to go dark. And Orange begins to get really anxious.

programme.title: Greed Is Good?
programme.desc: When Jestro uses the Book of Greed to rob Auremville of its riches, he also gets Lance's parents as prisoners and these demanding rich folks are too much for even monsters to handle. Jestro's not sure what to do with his new castle in the Lava Lands. “Every castle needs a big chamber filled with treasure” says the Book of Monsters so they've got to go out looting! The BOM convinces Jestro to call forth GENERAL MAGMAR, and Jestro appoints him as “general manager” of “castle operations,” much to Magmar's dismay. Meanwhile, Jestro and the BOM find the BOOK OF GREED. This will allow them to make greedy, rapacious monsters that will bring them all the treasure they want to fill their castle! They'll head to the richest town in the realm – AUREMVILLE! Meanwhile, in Auremville, the NEXO-Knights arrive for a huge “Gold is Good” ball at Lance's house. When the Monsters finally arrive in Auremville, a battle breaks out and the greedy monsters make off with everything…including Lance's parents, Goldie and Cuthbert Richmond who are clad in the finest golden garments and so look valuable! Lance will now be forced to live…poor. The Knights have to get his parents back. Meanwhile, his parents – Cuthbert and Goldie Richmond –think their imprisonment in Jestro's gold-filled castle is a “spa holiday” with the worst service. They order Magmar and the monsters around like servants and drive them all crazy. The Knights pile into the Fortrex and head for the Lava Lands, formulating a plan along the way to free Lance's parents. In a village half-way to Jestro's Castle, the Knights run into…Jestro and his monsters headed the other way with Lance's parents and all the gold they've stolen. There's a big fight, until they realize they might have the same goal and decide to deal. The BOM wants to give them back all the gold and Lance's parents. Lance says “No deal.” “We'll take the gold, you can keep my parents.” It's a weird and comical stand-off. Finally, Clay convinces Lance he has to take his parents back even if they don't always get along (and, it's the only way to get the gold back.)

programme.title: Peak Performance
programme.desc: The search for the Sandman leads Mateo and the others to the tallest mountain in the Dream World, but Lunia's hourglass puts a target on their backs.

programme.title: The Anomaly
programme.desc: A surprise visit from the Chief Inspector of the Night Bureau forces Mateo to hide Z-Blob, who goes on an adventure in the heart of Brooklyn.

programme.title: The Digiverse And Beyond, The Elemental Masters
programme.desc: Tackling a puzzle about technology in Ninjago. A riddle requires the Ninja to consider the powers and history of the Elemental Masters.

programme.title: The Jade Princess
programme.desc: In the wake of an assassination attempt targeting the royal family, the ninja invite the royal princess, HARUMI, into their makeshift family. Lloyd glimpses someone escaping over the rooftops with a sack on their back. Fearing it is the kidnapped princess, Lloyd takes up the chase! He discovers to his surprise, however, that the masked intruder is none other than the princess herself, who is not quite as docile or meek as she pretends. She has a habit of sneaking out of her chambers at night to feed the homeless who surround the Imperial Palace. This revelation only endears her to Lloyd more and Harumi and Lloyd quickly strike up a friendship. Unfortunately, trouble catches up to the ninja when the Sons Of Garmadon target the second Oni mask and attack the palace. The scope of the attack proves more than the Ninja were prepared for as the Sons of Garmadon detonate a series of subterranean bombs, bringing down part of the palace. Lloyd and Harumi escape onto the flying ship, DESTINY'S BOUNTY. But the victory is a pyrrhic one. The second Oni Mask has been stolen and Harumi's parents and Master Hutchins are feared lost.

programme.title: The Pranks
programme.desc: Stephanie finds the perfect front page story for the school paper! It's almost too good to be true. Emma and Andrea go undercover to solve the mystery of the two Jacobs.The friends are using their talents to pull a prank on Olivia. But who gets the last laugh?

programme.title: Andrea's Big Moment
programme.desc: When famous pop star Livi comes to Heartlake City to judge a talent show, our five friends Olivia, Mia, Andrea, Emma and Stephanie all decide to enter – and one of them, in particular, really wants to win but faces some serious challenge from an old rival. A talent show has come to Heartlake City and all the girls enter the talent competition hoping to impress the judges, especially their idol, pop star Chloe. No one wants a shot at stardom more than Andrea, which is why the other girls are surprised when she doesn't show up to practice before the first round of the competition. Very nearly eliminated prior to the big show, Andrea panics and throws herself into an intense practice-training mode, even shutting her friends out when they're trying to help her with her performance. Just moments before her live TV debut, Andrea realizes she's missing a key element to her act. Can she pull it off without her friends? And are the other girls willing to help after being pushed away?

programme.title: Kate's Island
programme.desc: The five friends leave for science camp that takes place on an island and during the trip, they meet the stand-offish Kate – but they soon realize that there's more to her than meets the eyes and that you shouldn't judge the book by its cover. No one is more excited than Olivia about science camp at a beautiful rocky offshore island with a lighthouse. But Olivia quickly gets off on the wrong foot with a mysterious girl named Kate who seems obsessed with a medallion necklace and the island's rumored history of pirates and treasure. Even worse for Olivia, Kate seems to be growing extra chummy with Mia, even sneaking around the island with her late at night. With the help of Stephanie, Emma and Andrea, Olivia is determined to get to the bottom of the girls' secret friendship and find out once and for all what they're searching for on the island, but they better not let Mrs. Stevens catch them out of their cabin past curfew.

programme.title: The Grand Hotel
programme.desc: The five friends help out at The Grand Hotel that Andrea's family just bought during what was supposed to be a quiet weekend until a hotel critic arrives unexpectedly. The girls are ready to do everything to make a great impression – but things don't quite go according to plan. Andrea, Stephanie, Olivia, Emma and Mia have come for breakfast at the fanciest hotel in town, now owned by Andrea's family. When Andrea's aunt has to leave town, the girls volunteer to run the hotel for the weekend with the help of quirky Grandma Jean. This is the perfect job for Stephanie's expert managerial skills but then the hotel suddenly fills to capacity with guests, including a hotel critic that can make or break the hotel's reputation! Now the girls find themselves in over their heads juggling reception, childcare, food prep and waitressing, a dog-walking service and a testy chef who quits on them in the middle of dinner. Unfortunately, much of this is their own fault. Can the girls save the Grand Hotel from themselves?

programme.title: Ninjaball Run
programme.desc: When the ninja learn that Darreth's Mojo Dojo is to be destroyed and Darreth doesn't have the money to save it, our heroes enter the annual NinjaBall Run to win its cash prize in order to save the dojo. As Lloyd continues to train and unlock his hidden powers, the Ninja learn land developers are going to destroy Darreth's Mojo Dojo unless Darreth can find the money to save it. The Ninja decide to enter their Ninja Tank into the annual NinjaBall Run cross-country rally to try to win its cash prize. Revisiting past characters who also enter the race, the high-speed derby will only grow more dangerous as Garmadon enters his Black Bounty, realizing this is the perfect chance to use his Mega-Weapon and rid the ninja. In the end, the Ninja will discover a few secrets within their Ninja Tank, allowing them to beat Garmadon's Bounty by a millisecond and saving Darreth's Dojo with their well-deserved cash prize. And as a final surprise, the Ninja steal back the Destiny's Bounty and make it their own once again.

programme.title: Child's Play
programme.desc: When the Ninja interrupt Lord Garmadon from using his Mega-Weapon to ‘turn back the clock' and bring to life the fossils of a monster, the Ninja are accidentally hit and turned into kids and are now forced to enlist Lloyd's help to battle the awakened monster. Tired of intense training, Lloyd yearns to play and enjoy his youth. The Ninja remind Lloyd that along with great power, comes great responsibility. When the Ninja interrupt Lord Garmadon from using his Mega-Weapon to ‘turn back the clock' and bring to life the fossils of a monster, the Ninja are accidentally hit and soon discover they've been turned into kids! Seeking Lloyd's help and relying on childhood antics, the five ninja kids must destroy the reawakened monster that's hunting them in the city. In the end, Lloyd makes the difficult decision and sacrifices his youth in order to save them from the beast, turning forward the clock and turning Lloyd into a young man. Sensei Wu fears now that since Lloyd is young man, the final battle of good versus evil approaches sooner than he had ever expected.

programme.title: The Surge
programme.desc: After a time of peace, the Ninja are called back into action. The spirit of the defeated Overlord has infected the electric grid of Ninjago and is using all available technology to exact his revenge on Lloyd. Nowhere is safe but fortunately, the Ninja have been given the powerful Techno Blades. But the only problem is that they have no idea how to use them. Time has passed since the Ultimate Battle, and while the Golden Ninja continues to watch over Ninjago, the other Ninja have become complacent as schoolteachers. When a mysterious invitation from genius Cyrus Borg brings them to the futuristic New Ninjago City, trouble surges when a digital virus of the Overlord takes over technology. The Golden Ninja makes a heroic entrance, only to find out his Golden Power supercharges the enemy. Sensei Wu stays behind so that the Ninja can escape with the only thing that can save Ninjago's future – Borg's Techno Weapons.

programme.title: The Art Of The Silent Fist
programme.desc: The Ninja go into hiding but an army of the Digtial Overlord's evil robotic Nindroids are hunting them wherever they go. Their only chance is to learn the secrets of the Techno blades and use them to cut all power to save Ninjao from this technological menace. The Ninja hide out at a safe place void of technology – Sensei Garmadon's Sanctuary. That night, Zane is visited by Borg's female robo-assistant, Pixal. She warns them that the Digital Overlord is after Lloyd's Golden Power in order to become flesh, but the Techno Blades can reboot the system and erase him for good. After a highly advanced army of Nindroids attacks the Sanctuary, Lloyd flees with his father into the wilderness of Ninjago, while the rest set off on a quest to turn off all power in Ninjago, so that they can erase the Digital Overlord once and for all.

programme.title: The Book Of Total Badness
programme.desc: The NEXO-Knights must fight Jestro's Monsters of Destruction which are attacking all over the Kingdom. But Merlok smells a trap…is he right? In a dark, destroyed part of the kingdom, Jestro arrives at the ruins of a HUGE castle. The Book of Monsters knows this place: the great evil wizard Monstrux lived here. The Book sniffs out some powerful magic in the ruins: “The Book of Destruction.” With this, The Book tells Jestro they can destroy the NEXO-Knights and then attack the King's Castle and cause massive destruction. Jestro creates destructive monsters and sends them all over the realm, so the Knights must separate and fight single combats all over the place. The Knights lose these battles (lesson: they have to work as a team!) And, just when the Knights are scattered across the Kingdom, Jestro attacks the King's Castle! It looks like all is lost. When Aaron, who has escaped, returns to see Jestro's attack, he realizes he must gather his fellow Knights. Merlok says it's very dangerous, but Aaron says he must take the risk to gather the Knights and save Knighton.

programme.title: The Might And The Magic
programme.desc: Aaron races across the kingdom to gather the NEXO-Knights as Jestro and his Destructive Monsters attack the King's Castle. The Knights must get back to the capitol in time, or Jestro will rule the kingdom! Jestro, while still attacking the King's Castle, has second thoughts until the Book of Monsters orders the mad jester to feed him another magic book he's found (and has been saving.) It's the powerful “Book of Revenge!” Now, combining the powers of Revenge and Destruction, Jestro and his monsters will get their vengeance on King Halbert and the Kingdom of Knighton. Jestro and his monsters lay siege…will they destroy the castle?! Meanwhile, Aaron races across the Kingdom gathering the NEXO-Knights one at a time. As each Knight rejoins the group, they become a more and more powerful team. They even get Robin to join them as the Black Knight in his repaired power suit. Our Knights arrive, finally regrouped, fight off Jestro, save the castle and the King. It's a glorious victory! The King is so pleased after seeing how the brave NEXO-Knights saved his kingdom, he allows Macy to join them as an official NEXO-Knight.

programme.title: Back To School
programme.desc: When the NEXO-Knights are sloppy in a fight with Jestro, Merlok 2.0 sends them back to the Knights' Academy. Not only for a brush-up but to find out what Jestro is after in its hallowed halls. As they Knights battle Jestro – in a somewhat haphazard and lazy way – they discuss the fact that Jestro never wins and that they're always getting over on him. Despite defeating the jerky Jester and his evil Book, Merlok 2.0 discovers that something about the attack on the village is tied to the Knights' Academy. It looks like that's where they'll strike next. It wouldn't hurt for the Knights to go “back to school” to watch for Jestro and for some refresher training. Merlok is sure Jestro wants something at the Academy, but he doesn't know what it is. The Knights are very much “fish out of water” at the academy, even with the “cool kids” – Robin and Ava – showing them around. The next generation of Knights is being taught to integrate the NEXO-Magic of Merlok into their fighting techniques and these kids are good (so good, they initially kick the lazy, know-it-all Knight's butts!) Their old principal, the ever-ornery Headmaster Brickland, sets them straight: they're all still slackers, and they better get their acts together (especially Lance!) The Knights take shifts as “library helpers” much to the delight of the old squirebot librarian, MARGE. They're convinced Jestro is after a book…isn't he always after a book? When Jestro attacks, the Knights help organize the students and there's a big fight in the Academy Library versus Jestro and his Monsters. They drive Jestro off without letting him steal any books! Victory! But as Jestro leaves, we see him holding what the Book of Monsters really wanted: a snow globe with a castle in it that was sitting on the librarian's desk. In the Lava Lands, Jestro throws the snow globe into a volcano and it frees the massive Castle of Monstrux from its snowy magic prison

programme.title: Greed Is Good?
programme.desc: When Jestro uses the Book of Greed to rob Auremville of its riches, he also gets Lance's parents as prisoners and these demanding rich folks are too much for even monsters to handle. Jestro's not sure what to do with his new castle in the Lava Lands. “Every castle needs a big chamber filled with treasure” says the Book of Monsters so they've got to go out looting! The BOM convinces Jestro to call forth GENERAL MAGMAR, and Jestro appoints him as “general manager” of “castle operations,” much to Magmar's dismay. Meanwhile, Jestro and the BOM find the BOOK OF GREED. This will allow them to make greedy, rapacious monsters that will bring them all the treasure they want to fill their castle! They'll head to the richest town in the realm – AUREMVILLE! Meanwhile, in Auremville, the NEXO-Knights arrive for a huge “Gold is Good” ball at Lance's house. When the Monsters finally arrive in Auremville, a battle breaks out and the greedy monsters make off with everything…including Lance's parents, Goldie and Cuthbert Richmond who are clad in the finest golden garments and so look valuable! Lance will now be forced to live…poor. The Knights have to get his parents back. Meanwhile, his parents – Cuthbert and Goldie Richmond –think their imprisonment in Jestro's gold-filled castle is a “spa holiday” with the worst service. They order Magmar and the monsters around like servants and drive them all crazy. The Knights pile into the Fortrex and head for the Lava Lands, formulating a plan along the way to free Lance's parents. In a village half-way to Jestro's Castle, the Knights run into…Jestro and his monsters headed the other way with Lance's parents and all the gold they've stolen. There's a big fight, until they realize they might have the same goal and decide to deal. The BOM wants to give them back all the gold and Lance's parents. Lance says “No deal.” “We'll take the gold, you can keep my parents.” It's a weird and comical stand-off. Finally, Clay convinces Lance he has to take his parents back even if they don't always get along (and, it's the only way to get the gold back.)

But they learn that the wicked chamberlain is pilfering the King's possessions.

programme.title: The Smurfiest Of Friends
programme.desc: Brainy Smurf had one friend: Clumsy Smurf. But poor Clumsy is so, well, clumsy, that Brainy refuses to see him again. So now he is left without anyone willing to listen to him. Maybe Buddy, the good-looking imp met by chance near the Great Oak can be a pal for Brainy....

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - Poltersmurf: There are few things Grandpa Smurf enjoys more than telling a good scary story, and there are few Smurfs who don't love to listen. But things get a little too much for Brainy Smurf when Grandpa tells of Poltersmurfs, and Poltersmurfs begin harrowing Brainy...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - Greedy And The Porridge Pot: The good fairy, Guinilda gives Greedy a magic porridge pot that Brainy causes to overflow into the village and forest. The good-hearted fairy hurries to the rescue and then asks for the pot back to give to an orphanage of hungry children.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - The Most Unsmurfy Games: To prove the worth of his Big Book of Wilderness Survival, Brainy takes the Smurflings to the swamp. Where, thanks to his expert advice, the tiny group gets totally lost, is then caught in quicklime and trapped by King Bullrush of the Wartmongers. Fortunately, Bullrush is in a playful mood and devises a Smurf hunt. Unfortunately, Brainy believes he is a born leader...

programme.title: Smurf Box Derby
programme.desc: Handy Smurf makes another invention: the Smurfmobile. Each Smurf has his – or her – customized vehicle and all, or almost all, the Smurfs enjoy a little spin... But then the evil wizard Gargamel gets hold of the idea and starts making trouble for the Smurfs...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - The Noble Stag: His wicked cousin, Malcolm the Mean, who plans to kill him and mount him in his trophy room, has turned King Gerard into a black stag. The little Smurfs help their friend. When King Gerard is transformed back into his human form, Malcolm becomes imprisoned in the body of the stag.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - Curried Smurfs: In Ancient India, the unscrupulous fakir Gargapuri sells the Smurfs to the Rajah for his private zoo. Only Grandpa, Wild Smurf and Jokey are free, so it's up to them to sneak into the palace and rescue their friends. Along the way they free all the caged animals in the Raja's menagerie.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - Hopping Cough Smurfs: The evil wizard Gargamel spreads the forest with the germs of the uncontrollable hopping cough. Baby Smurf is the first victim and all the Village of the Smurfs goes frantic with worry... Fortunately, Papa Smurf thinks there might be a cure.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - The Sorcerer Smurf: Gargamel creates the legend of Sorcerer Smurf to lure Papa Smurf and his smurfy friends into a trap at his mountain hideaway. Papa Smurf outwits the wicked wizard with some of his own magic and Gargamel is chased down the mountain and back to his castle.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - The Smurf Who Would Be King: Dreamy yearns to be King after reading a story about them. He falls through a whirlpool while on his ship and finds himself in the land of pokies who think Dreamy is their long-lost King. When he confronts the pokies' enemies, the Norfnags, he finds they aren't fearful at all. Dreamy bumps his head and wakes up to discover it was just a dream, yet finds a jewel in his cap, just like the ones the pokies mine for a living.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - April Smurf's Day: April Smurf's Day turns out to be not so funny when Gargamel dons a smurfberry bush disguise to capture the happy little Smurfs. Papa Smurf instructs Feathers to call the birds to attack the fake bush. After it is stripped, the captured Smurfs climb aboard Feathers and fly away.

programme.title: Beauty Is Only Smurf Deep
programme.desc: Periwinkle, a vain Pixie, is upset when her magic mirror tells her that Vanity is the fairest, not she. Periwinkle kidnaps Vanity, but the rest of the Smurfs come to Vanity's rescue. Periwinkle sees the error of her ways and they become friends.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - Never Smurf Off Till Tomorrow: A fierce wind carries the Smurfs' windmill away, with several Smurfs inside. Is Lazy Smurf really at fault or is an injustice being committed? Are the captive Smurfs going to be saved from the volcano's crater? Is Brainy going to smurf up his mouth for a moment?

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - Soothsayer Smurfette: When Smurfette meets this gentle old gypsy woman in the forest and receives a swirling multicoloured dress, she's delighted. How could she know that this woman is really the evil wizard Gargamel in disguise, and that there is a terrible spell on the beautiful dress?

programme.title: The Smurfs

programme.title: What's Inside?

""What is inside such seemingly simple objects surrounding us? How are the mechanisms that we use every day arranged? Maybe they work with the help of magic? Or maybe each system has a certain order?

programme.title: Try, Try Again
programme.desc: A van with Monkeys arrived at the Bear's house. They invite everyone to test themselves with the help of an attraction - a power meter. The Bear is confident that he will easily win the main prize. But things didn't go according to plan. And now the main strongman of the forest cannot do without the help of his friends.

programme.title: Princess and the Beast
programme.desc: Shocking and sensation! For the first time in our forest! A couple of tourists broke into the Bear's house without an invitation in search of impressions and cool photos. And there they are - just a sleepy Bear and Masha, who really wants to play. Rejoice tourists! You will have impressions, photos, and obstacle course from here and to the city itself!

programme.title: First Day Of School
programme.desc: With the beginning of September, Masha, like all the children wants to go to school and asks the Bear to make her one. Overwhelmed with enthu-siasm, the Bear completes the task and the next day Masha sits at a brand new desk and tries to act as an attentive student but ends up bringing the Bear to absolute madness.

programme.title: Fishy story
programme.desc: Summer is a time of rest and miracles. How nice is just to sit on the river bank with your best friends! However, everything is not so simple in our story. The Bear didn't even suspect what kind of adventure he was going to find on his fishing trip. While Masha and She-Bear frightened by his sudden disappearance, explore the neighborhood, he ... however, you will find out everything yourself in our new episode.

programme.title: Don't Wake Till Spring!
programme.desc: The autumn has arrived. The Bear prepares for his winter bedtime by barricading himself from Masha inside the house. But the little girl manages to find her way indoors and causes yet another mess by awakening a whole swarm of bees. But all her games eventually stop and when the Bear cooks some porridge to feed the child, he discovers her fallen asleep.

programme.title: A Ghost Story
programme.desc: At first time in her life Masha is frightened in earnest, however this creepy story shook up the whole forest and now hardly anyone can stay away from these strange scenes! And what would you do if your own pillow and blanket turn into real ghosts?! A real ghost story, oh yeah!

programme.title: The Very Fairy Tale
programme.desc: Masha loves fairy tales and of course she believes that each fairy tale should lead to happy end, even if nothing contributes to it! That's how the story goes… The Bear still hopes to win the heart of the female Bear. He finds an ancient gondola at the bottom of the forest lake. The Bear decides to restore it and invites the female Bear for a romantic ride! No one would have expected that this story would perfectly match Masha's new hobby - puppet theatre.

programme.title: Time To Ride My Pony
programme.desc: The Bear's good friend, the Tiger, is back for a visit and they decide to spend the time together in an intellectual way – playing chess. Masha is immediately drawn into the game and to everyone's surprise, she outsmarts and outplays both the Bear and his friend with just one chess figure.

programme.title: The Grand Piano Lesson
programme.desc: The bear finds a beautiful black piano in the forest. He happily takes it home, fixes and tunes it and begins to play some music. Masha couldn't help staying away from this lovely instrument. She decides to become a world famous pianist, she asks the Bear to teach her how to play the piano.

programme.title: Arts and Crafts Day
programme.desc: Masha announces Arts and Crafts Day. Get your glue, pencils and any unnecessary things and let's create! The Bear is trying to sneak away on a fishing trip. But what will he catch if all his floats are gone for crafts? Is it Masha, to put her in a corner? Well, not this time. Friendship always wins in our creative contests!

programme.title: The Foundling
programme.desc: Occasionally Masha finds an egg, from which a penguin hatches. The Bear has to take double care now. He cooks special dishes and builds mini aqua park for little penguin and Masha. Finally the Bear figures out that the penguin will be happy only in suitable weather conditions and send the penguin Antarctica on a little plane.

programme.title: See You Later
programme.desc: This day will change Bear's life forever. To everyone's surprise, Masha has suddenly grown up, getting all the forest dwellers shocked by her exceptionally good behavior. Her sister Dasha is going to take her back to the big city, which really upsets the Bear and others.

programme.title: Sleeping Beauties
programme.desc: Masha is the best "mommy" in the world, but even she can not put Rosy to sleep. Bear offers a solution: a music box. And everything would have been fine, but the music box suddenly turns out to hold a surprise inside it!

programme.title: We Come In Peace!
programme.desc: In the courtyard of the Bear's house a spaceship makes an emergency landing. The aliens need to urgently replenish their supplies and return home. Only on the ground everything is arranged differently than at home. Masha and Mishka will help them to understand what's what, fix the ship and go back to home.

programme.title: Scary Story About Spooky Stories
programme.desc: Are you sure that you really like spooky stories? What if this kind of story will get you really thrilled? Listen to one classic story and don't say that you are not shocked after all!

programme.title: Soul Freezing Tale Of Grim Forest And Tiny Timid Bug
programme.desc: All children are afraid of the dark. Masha was afraid of it too and had to sit with a torch all night long! But once upon a time she came up with the tale about a tiny bug, which lived in the woods and was so afraid of the dark, that every rustle made its heart tremble! The bug suffered a lot until he realized that all tiny things you see in the dark just seem to be frightful and fear makes no sense at all!

programme.title: Terrible Truth About Those Who Are Afraid To Be Little
programme.desc: Everyone think that it's so scary to be little as there are so many things are not accessible for you! But in reality there is no difference how little you are if there is someone who cares for you and someone you care about…

programme.title: Gloomy Story About The Darkest Dreams
programme.desc: All children are keen on computer games! Everyone likes to shoot a couple of monsters before going to sleep. Tolik also liked to play shooters until the monsters attack him in reality in order to commit the revenge! Or…was it just a dream? Let's see...

programme.title: Sinister Saga Of A Sick Tummy And A Girl Who Was Afraid Of Doctors
programme.desc: Masha narrates a terrific story about one little girl who was afraid of doctors. And once upon a time she experienced one fantastic story…she decided to cook dinner for her dolls. She took some clay and made “meat balls” with “semolina porridge”. As the meal seemed tasty, Sima decided to eat a bit of her dinner too… And so she lies in her bad and feels a horrible stomachache. Nobody knows how long she would need to suffer, but when she woke up…she realized herself in hospital…near the real snow queen… who explained that medical treatment is not scary at all…though some other things are very fearsome! Oh yeah!

programme.title: Bloodcurdling Saga About Joyful Event
programme.desc: Everyone think that it's so scary to be little as there are so many things are not accessible for you! But in reality there is no difference how little you are if there is someone who cares for you and someone you care about…

programme.title: Grim Parable About Superstitious Girl
programme.desc: Some people happen to believe in all sorts of omens like black cats, wearing clothes inside out, prophetic dreams… Poor girl Lucy believed in that kind of stuff so much that was even afraid to go outside to play with her friends. And how could you go out if you were born in the year of Purple rabbit that promises…no matter what… You'll see…

programme.title: Terrifying True Story About Monsters And Those Who Fear Them
programme.desc: Are you afraid of monsters? Sure you are! Let me tell you a scary story about a boy who experienced a real fear…This story happened on an abandoned tractor factory. The boy lost a scoop from his toy-tractor and decided to look for it at the factory. So he goes up the stairs and sees a large female monster, who was about to paint her lips with a roller! As he kept walking he noticed more monsters playing domino! The boy was very terrified and about to cry, when he learnt that it was just a movie set and all the monsters were not real! They were just actors…Finally the boy realized that all the monsters from the books and movies are not real at all! But if want to see a real monster- watch a fly under a microscope!

programme.title: The Wolf and the Fox
programme.desc: Once upon a time there lived a fisherman with his wife. Nearby there lived the Fox. One day the man went to a frozen pond to fish. On his way he found the Fox, who pretended to be dead, and picked her up. The Man started to fish and fell asleep over an ice-hole. The Wolf saw this and was glad as he hoped to get some fish, but the Fox told the Wolf that it's her own fisherman and if he wants to eat some fish - he should put in his own tail in an ice-hole. The Wolf's tail froze in the ice and fishes made a cute Christmas tree out of it. The Man, his Wife, the Fox, the Cat and the Mouse finally pulled the Wolf's tail out of the hole and the New Year has finally come.

programme.title: The Wolf and the Seven Young Kids
programme.desc: This educative tale teaches us that caution should never be dismissed. Mother-Goat goes to pick up cabbage, leaving her seven kids alone at home. Hungry Wolf tries to get into the house imitating mother Goat's voice to fool the little yeanlings. He manages to deceive six kids, but the seventh, the smallest one, manages to hide in the oven. The Wolf tries to get into the house through the chimney, but here comes Mother-Goat and finds her seventh kid. She melts the stove, and the Wolf rushes into the forest with his tail burnt. The other six kids come back home and finally the family reunites.

programme.title: The Fox and the Rolling Pin

To teach her a lesson, the Cat got into a bag himself and when the Fox opened it in order to eat the Rooster, the Cat jumped out of it and frightened her. The point of the story is that “if you are well off you don't seek better”.

Despite Tsar's insidious plan, Yegor has successfully returned back home and even taught the king an important lesson not to envy other people.

programme.title: The Frog Princess

'Earther', Bran, has big dreams of a better life in this new world, but the odds are stacked against him. programme.title: I'M LIVE
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is the band MACGUFFIN! This band is composed of drummer SNOOQ vocalist and guitarist Byeon Ha-geum bassist UHI and guitarist Bae Joon-il. The band is named after a technique of the same name that advances a film's plot builds the narrative and helps push the story forward widely popularized by Alfred Hitchcock. Back in 2017 the quartet participated in the Arirang Competition and won the Grand Prize with their unique interpretation of Arirang. Then in 2018 they won the Golden Prize at the Penta Super Rookie and engraved their name in the minds of the public. The members recently completed their mandatory military duties and are so ready to impress listeners with their matured musicality. In this episode MACGUFFIN performs Sinpa Bucket List Highway and more to showcase their artistic prowess. Tune in to I'm LIVE and meet these four talented musicians!

programme.title: I'M LIVE
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is the soulful singer-songwriter GSoul! GSoul is a big name in the music industry. Known for his exceptional soulful voice and songwriting skills he garnered much attention even before his official debut. To further engrave his name in the minds of the public he took part in the competition show “Voice Korea 2020” last year and won first place impressing everyone with his outstanding musicality once again. This past February this artist released the duet Can Love Be Fair? with Ben to depict a couple experiencing unequal love. GSoul's soulful vocals definitely make this song more heartrending. In this episode GSoul performs Hate Everything Bad Habits Let Me Know Another Sad Love Song Broken Record as well as his solo version of Can Love Be Fair? Tune in to I'm LIVE this week and let this artist melt your soul!
